record.context_brief: Geometric reformulation of statistical regularity conditions
record.original_question: In asymptotic parameter-estimation theory for finite-dimensional models on infinite sample spaces, can the usual regularity assumptions be reformulated as geometric conditions on the corresponding submanifolds of an infinite-dimensional manifold?

evidence.quote: Is it possible to express such conditions as some geometric conditions on submanifolds?

artifact.status_search_result: The question is posed as an open problem in a recent compilation of open problems from the Foundations of Differential and Information Geometry 2025 discussion. No solution or systematic geometric reformulation of the standard asymptotic regularity conditions on submanifolds of infinite-dimensional statistical manifolds appears in the literature; foundational frameworks (Pistone–Sempi exponential manifolds, Newton's Hilbert-manifold construction, etc.) provide the setting but do not resolve the equivalence with classical regularity hypotheses.

status_evidence.title: Open problems in information geometry: a discussion at FDIG 2025
status_evidence.snippet: Is it possible to express such conditions as some geometric conditions on submanifolds?
